steps.note: Find any value bigger than both neighbours (outside the array counts as −∞). The array isn't sorted — the slope at the middle still tells you which half must hold a peak.
4 (pos 3) < 6 to its right — uphill. Keep climbing: a peak is in 4..6.
5 (pos 5) > 2 to its right — downhill. A peak is at mid or to its left: 4..5.
6 (pos 4) > 5 to its right — downhill. A peak is at mid or to its left: 4..4.
Range closed on position 4: 6 is a peak. 3 comparisons for 7 values — O(log n), without ever sorting.
